variant.briefing:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from [Location] and taken to [Destination]. 

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
